# Lamentations 5 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 5:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Our-water for-money we-drink; our-wood comes at-a-price. |
| LOGOS | We must pay for the water we drink; the wood we get must be bought. |
| PNEUMA | We have to pay for water that used to be free. We have to buy our own firewood. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning.

---

## 5:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Upon our-necks we-are-pursued; we-are-weary — no-rest is-given to-us. |
| LOGOS | Our pursuers are at our necks; we are weary, we are given no rest. |
| PNEUMA | Those who pursue us are breathing down our necks. We're exhausted but not allowed to rest. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning.

| PNEUMA | We submitted to Egypt and Assyria just to get enough food to survive. |
